description: This Java source file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application, which acts as the launcher activity. It manages the UI components including fragment transactions for displaying a CardEmulationFragment, handles menu actions for toggling logs, and sets up logging infrastructure.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: The main launcher activity managing the UI, fragment transactions, menu options, and logging setup.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and adds the CardEmulationFragment if none exists.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares the menu, toggles visibility and title of the log toggle item.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, particularly toggling the log display.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up the logging chain with wrappers and filters, connects to the log fragment for on-screen logging.
